sections.brief: Ancestors the texts name in their own words: Hobbes (Land), the Austrian school renounced ('From Mises to Carlyle', 2010), Hoppe's king-as-owner vs caretaker, Carlyle (three essays 2009-10; slavery line in Yarvin's voice, preceding paragraph unread), Burnham and Frederick the Great (Tait 2019; Land p. 6); claimed vs faithful lineage. Figures: time; compare

Technocracy Inc. (Scott and Hubbert 1933, energy certificates, the Technate, Hotel Pierre collapse); Joshua N. Haldeman's documented record (1936-41 Technocracy, 1940 arrest and $200 fine, Social Credit, Protocols defence, apartheid praise, d. 1974); Musk's own words only (2019 'Martian Technocracy' post, 2016 Mars direct democracy, 11 Feb 2025 'we live in a bureaucracy'); Lepore and Townley; the 90-year plot as circulating claim; family conflation barred. Figures: time; compare

Exit (Hirschman vocabulary; Thiel's Cato essay 13 Apr 2009 and 1 May follow-up; Seasteading Institute 2008, $500k seed, $1.25m vs $1.7m, French Polynesia lapse); Hoppe, Mises Institute, PFS, 'no tolerance' passage, Land's 'Odd Marriages'; the cybernetic strand; disputes (Hoppe's 2025 reply to Kofman; Brassier); worst-case reading tested.
